summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs launched Muse Image and previewed Muse Video, agentic media-generation models with tool use, self-refinement and test-time compute scaling, rolling out across Meta AI, Instagram and WhatsApp.

mechanisms.reason: The model is designed to spend more test-time compute (reasoning tokens, tool calls, self-refinement steps) per generation to improve quality, increasing work done per request.
mechanisms.quote: With more test-time compute, the model reasons more, uses more tool calls, and uses more self-refinement steps to improve its generations.

mechanisms.reason: The model operates as an agent invoking search and code-execution tools rather than a single static generation call, and is deployed at consumer scale across Meta's apps.
mechanisms.quote: Instead of directly mapping prompts to images, Muse Image operates as an agent: it invokes search and coding tools to improve accuracy, self-refines its own generations, and improves through scaling test-time compute.

mechanisms.reason: The document describes a first demonstration of agentic, tool-using, self-refining image generation with emergent behavior, a new task class for media generation models.
mechanisms.quote: We didn’t design this behavior. Instead, it emerged during RL training simply because self-refinement produced better images and therefore higher reward.

practices.reason: A new released model adds agentic tool use, multi-reference composition and test-time reasoning scaling to image generation, worth evaluating for products needing precise, grounded image generation.
practices.quote: Muse Image is our most advanced image generation model yet: it follows instructions faithfully, edits with precision, and composes from multiple references.

practices.reason: The lab reports internal ablation win rates and Elo scores to justify design choices, which is useful measurement practice but not a transferable method or independently verifiable instrument.
practices.quote: Muse Image improves with search tool use. Win rate from internal ablation.

notable_reason: A major lab demonstrates test-time compute scaling and agentic tool use applied to image generation, a pattern that increases inference compute per request and signals growing demand for test-time compute infrastructure.
